pappus-mathematics.synagoge.evidence: Manual inspection of Hultsch volume I title (PDF12: Librorum II, III, IV, V reliquiae), the surviving opening at printed2, and the Greek running/book headings at printed30,178,304. The unheaded first division is the surviving part of BookII, not BookI. Chapters retain the source's numbers; no lost text is reconstructed.

apollonius-geom.conica.evidence: Manual inspection of the Greek BookIV opening and epistle at printed2, proposition1 at printed4 and proposition57 at printed94. The facing Latin headings independently read Conicorum Liber IV. First1K's section headings alpha through nu-zeta are retained under BookIV; missing BooksI–III require volumeI, not an offset within this source.
